convention: Frame axes: x forward, y left, z up, origin on the ground at the hull's middle. half_extents_m is the hull box (z: half the roof height). pivot_m is the turret ring centre; muzzle_m is from the pivot (turret frame). Measured stations are in the same axes.

thresholds.hull_dimension: fix when off by more than max(0.10 m, 3 %)
thresholds.pivot_x: fix when off by more than 0.15 m
thresholds.pivot_z_and_muzzle: same as a hull dimension: max(0.10 m, 3 % of the value)

published.source: weaponsystems.net ZTQ15 and Chinese press figures: 7.5 hull, 9.2 gun forward, 3.3 wide with appliqué, 2.5 to the turret roof

measured.from_side_photo: assets/references/type15/eastern_type_15_ztq_15_light_tank-side.jpg (low resolution, gun raised): the turret is about 55 % of the hull's length (about 4.0 m) and its centre sits about 0.15 m behind the hull's middle

verdicts.source: side photo; the model's turret centre agrees

notes.why: the frame's size and pivot agree with the published figures and the side photo. The shape is the art's: a flat wedge front, flat slab sides of modular armour and a tall, square bustle box (the display photo and the VT-5 quarters)

gaps: No drawing exists (Commons, the-blueprints.com and the open web searched 2026-11-11), so there is no overlay. The Q4 ladder's third step (a generated orthographic view) is left to slice 19, which rebuilds the turret anyway.

questions.9: ZTQ-15 'turret shape seems wrong' is art.
